verdict.rationale: The e-Services for Business landing page states that "all other services are available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week." That is an up-front statement of operating hours, and the phrasing implies some services have restricted windows listed on the same page. No session timeout or per-day transaction limit is published anywhere in the evidence, and the quoted line does not itself show which services are restricted or what their hours are. missing for 10: published session-timeout duration, any per-day limit disclosure, the explicit restricted-hours windows for the excepted services, independent or hands-on corroboration.
